text: Prompt! ... Ready! Commit! Push! ... Auto-merge! Close your laptops! Buy more GPUs. Now listen to me. Every company is going to run its own software factory. Tokens go in, software comes out, and the factory never sleeps. So you build it, you feed it, and you are going to love it.
voice_description: A cheerful but intense Taiwanese-American tech executive in his early sixties, barking orders like a drill sergeant while clearly enjoying himself. Light accent, bright mid-range voice with a little gravel, loud and fast on commands, then warm and confident when he explains. Clean close-mic studio recording, no reverb.
